Payments.//PublicBaseUrl: Public origin of this service. Gateways are told to POST notifications to {PublicBaseUrl}/api/webhooks/{gatewayKey}. Unset means no webhooks are requested and payments are resolved by polling.

paynet.//BaseUrl: One host for both environments - Paynet picks test or live from the API key, not the URL.
paynet.//Processors: One gateway key is registered per slug: paynet-arca, paynet-idram, paynet-telcell.
paynet.//Credentials: Per merchant, referenced by MerchantGatewayAccount.CredentialRef. Never commit real keys - inject them as Gateways__paynet__Credentials__<ref>__ApiKey.
